name: Karl Knutsson
contribution: After King Christopher's death in 1448, Karl was elected king of Sweden and briefly king of Norway, but was forced to relinquish the latter to Christian I of Denmark.
legacy: This person represented a growing nationalist tendency among the Swedish aristocracy which tried first to subjugate the other Scandinavian countries under Sweden but soon focused on dissolving the Kalmar Union.

checks.lead: Karl Knutsson Bonde (c. 1408–1470), also known as Charles VIII and called Charles I in Norwegian contexts, was King of Sweden (1448–1457, 1464–1465 and 1467–1470) and King of Norway (1449–1450).
